name: guardiantus-base
description: Baseline signature set shipped with Guardiantus AV. Patterns are stored hex-encoded so this file does not itself trip on-access scanners.

hashes.name: Guardiantus.SelfTest.HashProbe
hashes.description: Harmless self-test file used to verify that hash-based detection is working. Create it with: printf 'GUARDIANTUS-AV-SIGNATURE-SELFTEST-FILE-DO-NOT-REMOVE\n' > probe.txt

patterns.name: EICAR-Test-File
patterns.description: EICAR anti-malware test file. Harmless by design; used to verify that a scanner is live.

patterns.name: Backdoor.PHP.WebShell.Eval
patterns.description: PHP web shell executing attacker-supplied POST data

patterns.name: Backdoor.PHP.WebShell.Assert
patterns.description: PHP web shell executing attacker-supplied request data via assert()

patterns.name: Trojan.PowerShell.HiddenEncoded
patterns.description: PowerShell launched with no profile, hidden window and a base64 payload

patterns.name: Trojan.Win32.ReflectiveLoader
patterns.description: Reflective DLL loader export, common in post-exploitation implants
